asr.full_text: Unlimited Flexibility Speed, low fees, Unlimited Flexibility Are these three possible to be found in the same Blockchain? Is it even possible? Well, today we are going to talk about such a platform That is, Avalanche Let's see why people think this is a very important point about C chain here, which is that it is EVM compatible. It means, it works 100% with Ethereum virtual machine. What is the benefit of this? There is a huge benefit. Developers can easily bring Ethereum apps to Avalanche without any major changes and without any major changes. Because of this, it will be very easy to use Avalanche. Just one to two seconds. It's a little hard to believe, isn't it? But this is true. The time at which a transaction in avalanche is permanently and unchanged is the same. That is, transactions happen almost instantly. Any confusion in the network is completed cleanly without folks like us. This consensus mechanism is based on proof of stake. So there is no point in mining with large computers. If the transaction fees in the network are paid in AVAX coin, then the collected fees will burn. That means they will be permanently removed from circulation. This will reduce the supply of AVAX coins in the long run and it will be even rarer. If this burning mechanism is one, there is only available on one Avalanche. This is its speciality. So, the problems we discussed in the beginning, i.e. slow transactions, high fees, can be answered in just two words by the Avalanche. Speed and flexibility. The entire architecture of these two pillars, i.e. those three chains, its consensus, and subnets. After seeing all this, a big question arises. In the future, will the internet become a big network connected to one subnet? If that is true, will Avalanche technology be able to handle that change? What do you say? This is something to be considered for sure.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it provides a beginner-focused educational explanation of Avalanche, including its speed, fees, scalability, and EVM compatibility. Its disclaimer to do independent research and its like, subscribe, comment, and related-video prompts are described as ordinary channel engagement rather than conditions for obtaining AVAX, returns, or access to a financial transaction.
